name: Rajasthan
intro: Much of the land is desert, and much of what families carry from here is an answer to scarce water.

carries.title: Dal baati churma
carries.text: A Rajasthani thali with dal baati and churma, from a state where much of the land is desert.

carries.title: Chand Baori
carries.text: A stepwell in Abhaneri, in Dausa district: deep steps built down to the water in a dry land.
